mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) when FEDFUNDS declines by more than 0.25% over the prior 3 months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sub-4.0% unemployment rate indicates a tight labor market that typically precedes inflation acceleration and monetary policy tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) when UNRATE is below 4.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous expansion in housing starts and retail sales (both above their 12-month moving averages) signals robust consumer demand, which drives corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) when both HOUST and RSAFS are above their 12-month moving averages, or the interaction term in a regression has a coefficient not significantly different from zero (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a decline in industrial production relative to its trend indicates slowing economic momentum, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) during late-cycle expansion periods when INDPRO declines by more than 0.5% from its 12-month moving average, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in monthly payroll employment over the past three months signals a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) when PAYEMS increases by more than 100k in the prior 3 months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPI inflation rate exceeding 2.5% indicates accelerating price pressures that typically prompt monetary policy tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) when CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 2.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in industrial production and housing starts (both below their 12-month moving averages) indicates a broad-based economic slowdown, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) when both INDPRO and HOUST are below their 12-month moving averages, or the interaction term in a regression has a coefficient not significantly different from zero (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, a rise in the federal funds rate compresses equity valuations through higher discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) during monetary tightening cycles when FEDFUNDS rises by more than 0.25% in the prior month, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
